title: 巴克莱Emmanuel Cau：权益配置不再理所当然，债券吸引力正在上升？
speaker: Emmanuel Cau

segments.en: Look, we still as a house, we still have a preference for equities over bonds. I mean, definitely, we think the backbone of this economic super cycle, which is AI boom, investment boom, is still as lens, we'll carry on and we'll keep supporting earnings into next year.
segments.zh: 我们作为一个机构，仍然偏好权益资产而非债券。我们肯定认为这个经济超级周期的支柱，即人工智能繁荣和投资繁荣，仍然会持续，并继续支撑明年的盈利。

segments.en: And on the other hand, look in the backdrop of relatively high inflation and tight-term monetary conditions, we don't see a strong case to be in bonds, but look definitely, look as things are risk reward here is getting a bit more balance for the bond market and the US one in particular, right, you know, now you are getting paid a bit more to express duration
segments.zh: 另一方面，在相对较高的通胀和紧缩货币条件的背景下，我们不认为有强烈理由配置债券，但债券市场的风险回报正变得更加平衡，尤其是美国市场，现在持有久期能获得更多回报。

segments.en: and at the same time, we are seeing a bit more cracks maybe forming for the equity market, right? So I think the view we have on the equity market is pretty optimistic, but more and more reluctantly, if you see what I mean, why I think the bond market is starting to become a bit more of a company's case here, right?
segments.zh: 同时，我们看到权益市场可能正在出现更多裂痕。所以我们对权益市场的看法相当乐观，但越来越不情愿，你明白我的意思吗？我认为债券市场开始变得更有竞争力。

segments.en: So I think we are sticking to a view that earnings should ultimately be the big differentiator and as long as earnings are growing very strongly as they do, that should still support the equity market.
segments.zh: 所以我们坚持认为盈利最终将是最大的区分因素，只要盈利像现在这样强劲增长，就应该仍然支撑权益市场。

segments.en: But because the valuation case to be in equities is again less company than it was and in the case of Europe, look, I do believe that at some point fiscal concerns political uncertainty and tight-term monetary condition with the ECB hiking rates and all-priced, you know, being very high will wait on the economy.
segments.zh: 但由于配置权益资产的估值理由不再那么充分，就欧洲而言，我相信在某个时点，财政担忧、政治不确定性和紧缩货币条件——欧洲央行加息且油价高企——将拖累经济。

segments.en: So we are a bit more of a pressure than for the US or Europe here.
segments.zh: 因此我们在这里面临的压力比美国或欧洲更大一些。
